v44 GT audit - exact-GT arenas judged WRONG
The four arenas whose GT is exact (bbox or count) use the official rule verbatim (OSWorldG evaluator: first predicted point inside the box). This page shows cases the rule called WRONG so the GT itself can be audited: green = GT box/points (+ guide lines), red cross = model answer, right image zooms in. If the model looks right in many of these, the arena has label noise rather than the model being wrong.
